STS_KOMACHI_ONOZUKA-USE_DAIRI_PORTRAIT.h: Replaces the normal combat model with Dairi's Komachi art, if you prefer that.
STS_KOMACHI_ONOZUKA-SKIP_DANMAKU.title: Skip Attack/Danmaku animations.
STS_KOMACHI_ONOZUKA-SKIP_DANMAKU.hover.d: Some attacks have bullet-based animations to them when played. This options skips all that.
STS_KOMACHI_ONOZUKA-SHOW_NO_DISTANCE_ENE:
Displays hypothetical damage across all [gold]Distance[/gold] levels above enemies before [gold]Distance[/gold] has been applied to them.
When disabled, previews only appear once an enemy has [gold]Distance[/gold].
Recommended to turn on once you have played the character once.
STS_KOMACHI_ONOZUKA-SHOW_NO_DISTANCE_CAR:
Displays how much damage your cards will deal across different [gold]Distances[/gold] when targeting an enemy that doesn't have [gold]Distance[/gold] yet.
When disabled, previews only appear once the target has [gold]Distance[/gold].
Recommended to turn on once you have played the character once.
